info.title: Noetfield Public Discovery and Intake API
info.description: Read-only public corporate resources plus the existing Noetfield intake contract. Posting a request does not create a contract, agent assignment, payment, investment or completed work.

get.summary: Return static AI Factory route and lane config

post.summary: Submit an AI Factory Design Gate intake

get.summary: Public corporate identity, venture relationships, available commercial paths and documented agent actions

post.summary: Record authorized and consented human or agent-operated commercial enquiry
post.description: Submit with explicit contact consent. A record is durable only when the response contains intake_persisted=true and intake_id. Not a checkout, employment contract or Company OS assignment. Client-side consent collection is required; this endpoint itself does not establish authority to act for a third party.

request_id.description: Durable client-generated identifier, retain on retry for safe reconciliation.

metadata.description: Proposed role, area, attribution and recorded contact consent.

200.description: Platform confirmed persisted intake, includes intake_persisted=true and intake_id.

202.description: Only notification confirmed, includes intake_persisted=false and notification_reference; not an accepted application.

502.description: Record and notifications could not be delivered.

get.summary: Intake availability metadata (not proof of successful persistence)
